name: Wise Guys | 3g Live Resin | Mr. E
description: All the quality of our live resin carts, now in a more versatile format. This is the same uncut, minimally processed live resin—just without the hardware. That means more product for your money and total control over how you enjoy it. Whether you’re dabbing with a rig or elevating a joint into a “donut,” the experience is entirely yours to customize.
